prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop landing-page direction comp, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Render the first viewport and beginning of the next section of the real Clinimed Odontologia institutional website, edge to edge, with crisp readable Portuguese text and no browser frame. The visitor must immediately understand that Clinimed is a multidisciplinary dental clinic in Votuporanga and can schedule an evaluation by WhatsApp.
Input images: Image 1 is the official Clinimed logo and must be recognizable; Image 2 contributes only the sense of a real bright clinic interior. Do not reproduce the PLUG name or its blue/yellow branding visible in Image 2.
Concept: Pavilhão Clinimed — the page is a luminous care pavilion rather than a standard split hero. A continuous translucent green-glass arch carries the opening composition and visually connects the clinic, specialties, and appointment action. A floating top navigation appears as one elegant clear glass bubble with: “Início · Quem Somos · Tratamentos · Profissionais · Depoimentos · Blog · Contatos” and a distinct “Agende sua avaliação”.
Content: “Seu sorriso, cuidado por inteiro.” “Clínica multidisciplinar com mais de 40 procedimentos em um só lugar.” Primary action “Agendar pelo WhatsApp”. Supporting facts “Desde 2010”, “Votuporanga/SP”, “Atendimento humanizado”. Show the beginning of “Cuidado completo, no seu tempo” below.
Visual law: luminous off-white ground, deep Clinimed green, one lime light band, translucent green glass, pale wood, abundant daylight; bold contemporary sans typography with rounded humane details. One dominant architectural move, calm elsewhere.
Constraints: functional website mockup, clear hierarchy, no generic equal cards, no tooth stock photo, no invented awards, no prices, no extra logos, no watermark.
